description: Show the other participants of a message a short-lived status, such as ⏳ while you work on a reply or ✍️ while composing. Nothing is shown unless you call this. It is kept up while you work (up to 5 minutes) and expires on its own; reply, react and mark_read clear it, and an empty emoji clears it now.

emoji.description: a single emoji such as ⏳ or ✍️; empty clears

name: indicate

emoji.description: the emoji shown; empty when cleared

title: Show fmsg indicator
